claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: 6-benzylaminopurine is a plant cytokinin with no meaningful activity against human cancer cell lines at 2.5 uM; the retrieved literature describes plant hormone, antibacterial, and plant cell-cycle/apoptosis effects only, with no evidence of human cell killing.
